An older sufficient criterion covers one implication. Searches of primary full-text sections, targeted web equivalents, and mathematical records found no same statement; nonexhaustive terminology searches remain a risk.

value.rationale: A natural minimal singular boundary of the recent all-whiskered palindromicity theorem is completely classified: removing all leaves at one vertex while balancing neighboring versus nonneighboring leaf numbers yields symmetry exactly for simplicial vertices. A precise nonnegative obstruction and gamma transfer give structural information beyond prior sufficient conditions. The result holds for arbitrary base graphs, not a small instance or arbitrary finite slice.
